This website documents data processing pipeline developed for the study **From naive to native form: Shared kinematic signatures of conventionalization and acquisition in manual language**. The study resulted from a short-term collaboration between two projects: [**On the FLExibility and Stability of Gesture-speecH Coordination (FLESH)**](https://vicom.info/projects/on-the-flexibility-and-stability-of-gesture-speech-coordination-flesh-evidence-from-production-comprehension-and-imitation/){target="_blank"} and [**The Gesture-to-Sign Trajectory: Phonological Parameters in Production and Real-Time Comprehension**](https://vicom.info/project/the-gesture-to-sign-trajectory-phonological-parameters-in-production-and-real-time-comprehension/){target="_blank"}. The pipeline covers every step from raw data processing to feature extraction and analysis.

The repository associated with this project can be found on [Github](https://github.com/sarkadava/GestureToSign_KinematicTrajectory){target="_blank"}.


## Pipeline Overview
This study builds on multistep pipeline that serves to:

- prepare videos for processing (A)<br>
- perform motion tracking (B)<br>
- process resulting time series (C)<br>
- extract relevant features (D)<br>
- analyze with regards to research questions (E)<br>

Section F presents supplementary results. Note that in this workflow, each step builds on the previous one. However, it is possible to use parts of the workflow for different purposes. Section F presents extended version of results. 

::: callout-note
We only store and share only already pre-processed .csv files. They are available in the Github repository. If you are interested in the raw data, contact Door Spruijt.
:::
